name: Ichirou Yokohama
source:
The class president of IV-B and expected to finish as the valedictorian.

Known for his exceptional abilities in math and social skills, he gets along with people quite easily, some of which he plays pranks on. He is also a varsity player, excelling in volleyball. Most of the negativity surrounding him is usually attributed to his pride and occasional narrow-mindedness, suspecting it might be from his newfound rank among his batchmates.

[spoiler]Too bad he didn't get enough time to redeem himself. He is the third to be brutally murdered in L.C.'s deadly game.[/spoiler]
